transcript.text: Now I have the definitions confirmed: focus region = West, net revenue = amount - discount over completed orders, in cents. Let me query.

args.sql:
SELECT SUM(o.amount - o.discount) AS net_cents
FROM memory.bench.orders o
JOIN memory.bench.customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE c.region = 'West'
AND o.status = 'completed'
AND o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01 00:00:00'
AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00'
